_: Broly side-arc arena (docs/story.md 4f): a rocky wasteland crater. Northern Wastelands zone 3 area 6: its walled basin (cliff walls north and west, a pebble rim south and east; the basin's own collision) as the arena floor, the plain filled in around it (until 2026-10-21 Goku's pod crater from the same map sat on the plain above as scenery: it took 660 of the 896 tile slots, and the bigger ship needed them). Only the basin is walkable; Broly side chapter (docs/story.md 4g, data/story/broly.lscript): 224 px of plain added south of the basin as New Planet Vegeta's landing zone (the Saiyan ship: tools/shipart.py's 256 x 160 art on BG2 at x 192-447, y 504-663 (high enough that the camera shows the ground in front of it above the dialogue box), its doorway at x 304-335, the players step out of it on arrival; no save pad since 2026-10-20: the arena has no way out until Broly falls, so a save there could trap a weak party), walkable up into the basin over its pebble rim; Broly (sprite 159) waits in the basin; crossing the rim starts the confrontation and the fight (Broly stat 115 + Paragus stat 116, bosses.c). No flight spot: the players leave by the chapter's ending. No name banner (another planet).
